 Mr. P.K. Swain, Aga
 Coram:
 Mr. Justice R.K. Pattanaik
 Order
10.07.2025 I.A. No.314 of 2025 Order No.
02. 1.
Heard Mr. Dwibedi, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Instant I.A. is filed for condoning the delay in filing of the revision in terms of Section 5 of Limitation Act.

3. Delay of 131 days is reported as per the S.R.
4.
Recorded the submissions of learned counsel for the respective parties.

5. The petitioner has been sentenced for an offence under Section 376 I.P.C. and since he was in custody could not file the revision in time, hence, with such an explanation, the same is requested to be condoned.

6. Recording the objection of Mr. Swain, learned AGA for the State and upon considering the explanation of the petitioner, the Court is inclined to condone the delay and accordingly, it is ordered.
7.
The I.A. is disposed of with the delay of 131 days being condoned.
(R.K. Pattanaik) Judge 03. 1.
Heard Mr. Dwibedi, learned counsel for the petitioner.
